🚨 🎤 Stephen A smith wishes Detroit lions linebacker Jack Campbell a speedy recovery:

🗣️"Listen to me... please, everybody, just stop for a second and listen.
Before we talk about football, before we talk about wins and losses, we have to talk about human beings. What we saw happen to Jack Campbell today... it completely stops your heart. Seeing a young man of that magnitude, that kind of character, lying motionless on the field... it sends chills down your spine. It is a stark, terrifying reminder of the brutality and the sheer risk these athletes take every single time they step between those white lines.
My heart, my prayers, and my absolute best wishes go out to Jack Campbell, his family, his teammates with the Detroit Lions, and the entire organization. Football is a game we all love, but at moments like this, it takes a backseat to life, health, and safety. We are praying for you, Jack. Please God, let this young man have a full and speedy recovery. We need you back on your feet."
